Subject: Problem uploading W-9 — PDF/A validation error

Hi Ben / Laura,

We're trying to finish supplier onboarding for ClearForge but the portal keeps rejecting our W-9 PDF. The portal (Workday/Zip combined flow) returns: "PDF/A validation failed: FlateDecode/Filter decompression error (image stream)" and won't let us proceed.

I attached the file we tried (W9_signed_flattened.pdf) and a small validator log we pulled from the browser console (sample-w9-failed-log.txt). The file was generated from our accounting system (AcctStream v5) and it looks like images inside the PDF are compressed with a JBIG2/Flate mix.

Can you advise an accepted format or a workaround? We don't want to stall the PO kickoff and the buyer is waiting to issue the first PO.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
ClearForge — Head of Finance (onboarding@clearforge.com)

Attachments:
- W9_signed_flattened.pdf (application/pdf)
- sample-w9-failed-log.txt (text/plain)

Quick question so we scope the fix correctly: did you upload directly through the link in the Coupa/Workday invite, or via the DocuSign acknowledgement flow? If you have trouble, DocuSign is an option and we can accept a signed copy there.

I'll follow up with an internal ticket either way.

Hi Maya —

I dug into our onboarding validator and this looks like a strict PDF/A checker that chokes when image streams use nonstandard compression filters in combination (JBIG2 + Flate). A few practical steps to try on your side:

- Open the PDF in Adobe Acrobat (or Acrobat Reader) -> File -> Save As Other -> Reduced Size PDF, and choose compatibility to Acrobat 7.0 (PDF 1.6) or PDF 1.7.
- Or: Print -> Adobe PDF (this flattens/rewrites image streams) — then try upload.
- Ensure "Optimize for Fast Web View" is turned OFF.
- If possible, export the PDF without JBIG2 compression for black/white scans — use CCITT Group 4 instead, or export images as 8-bit grayscale.

If those aren't possible from your accounting system, please send the DocuSign envelope link or a signed PDF and we can accept it as a temporary manual upload. We will also file INF-4321 internally to relax the validator slightly to accept FlateDecode-only streams in mixed documents, but that will take engineering time and security review.

Thanks — attaching a short KB with steps:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-example-kb-steps (redacted link for thread)

—Laura Bennett
Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference

We tried both Save-As (PDF 1.7) and printing to Adobe PDF; the accounting tool still emits the same stream when it rasterizes some vendor stamps. The output contains JBIG2 segments we can't disable from AcctStream without a custom export.

We can do DocuSign immediately — I've prepared an envelope and the link is here: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE12345 (signed copy ready). If DocuSign isn't acceptable, we can SFTP a sanitized copy to a secure intake location.

We want to avoid manual rekeying of the W-9 fields if possible — that increases risk. Please confirm the preferred temporary path so we can finish onboarding and receive the PO.

Thanks,
